description:
Get the full financial assistance (charity care) policy we hold for one hospital or health center, with source URLs, short quotes, and last-checked date.
Use it when the patient asks what the policy says, or before you state a policy fact, so you can cite the source.
Pass the facility id from find_facilities (hospital CCN, slug, or health center id).
The answer says which tier the data is: verified, IRS filing (with tax year), state program, or legal baseline only. Tell the patient which one.
Null fields mean we do not know. Do not guess them.

facility_id.description: Hospital CCN (for example "220071"), facility slug, or health center org id.

name: get_policy
title: Get a facility's financial assistance policy
